title: The Underworld
description: Explore the vast strangeness of The Underworld dimension, with mobs, biomes, ores and everything you can imagine!
body:
## The Underworld!
Can you imagine a world almost the opposite of the overworld, but with a touch of strangeness? Well, the Underworld is here.

Some biomes are beautiful, others are distorted, others completely abstract, others common.

Mobs that, while resembling common mobs, have something different about them, which makes us wonder: are they the same mobs?

## How to travel to the Underworld?
You will need to create the **Reality Machine!** containing two parts: the **activator** and the **battery**. Connect the two by placing their respective blocks on the ground, with their wires fitting together. **By right-clicking on the Activator** (which looks like a monitor), you will teleport to the dimension (if you did something wrong, you will receive a warning of what is missing).

If you are in creative mode, just use the item "The Underworld Teleporter" to go directly to the dimension, working the same way as the machine.
